promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-09 (ercot-185) under the owner's standing structural standard and this session's explicit owner instruction ('if structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper'). *** THE PRE-REGISTERED MECHANICAL VERDICT IS REJECTED-AS-ARMED AND IS NOT REWRITTEN: 2 of 9 live gates fail (G-SHED, G-C3c). The promotion is the owner standard applied ON TOP of that verdict, not a re-scoring of it. *** WHAT IT IS: the run181 recipe plus ONE mechanism delta, ercot_partial_outage_shaped_derate=true — the fault-3 partial-layer CONSTRUCTION repair authorized by the signed owner ruling of the 2026-08-09 sitting (card D2 option C, 'G-COAL148 carried live'). NOT a composition change: the f_window x f_partial product is untouched and ERCOT-148/149 is NOT repealed. The partial-outage plateau stops imposing a multi-week MEDIAN OF DAILY MAXIMA as an HOURLY ceiling (FINDING-ercot172 §4 fault 3); the same plateaus over the same day spans carry a day-resolved profile clip(f0*sm[d]/median(sm[i:j]),0,1), f0 the incumbent's own flat factor and sm the frozen detector's own centered _SMOOTH_DAYS rolling median of daily-max CF — both medians of the SAME daily-maximum series differing only in the median's window, i.e. a grain refinement IN TIME (the temporal analogue of ercot-174's unit-grain refinement). ZERO new fitted scalars. Scaling commutes with the median so median(shaped)=f0 EXACTLY: a provable pure RE-SHAPING, never a net lift or cut (SP-6 max dev 0.0005; measured two-sidedness 49.8/51.1/50.8 % above vs the 100%-above signature of every composition arm). *** MEASURED OUTCOME: C3b-2024 0.205 -> 0.160 CROSSES ITS PASS BAR, so ERCOT's fail set narrows from {C3a-2023, C3b-2023, C3b-2024} to {C3a-2023, C3b-2023}; NRMSE-2024 3.007 -> 2.794; C3a-2024 +2.7% -> +1.4%. 2023 and 2025 are INERT (C3a -32.4 -> -32.5 and -7.9 -> -7.9; C3b 0.602 and 0.101 unchanged; tail 61/3 and shed 4/0 unchanged). DETERMINATION NOT-YET, unchanged — the promotion buys structural fidelity and one criterion-year, not a better public claim. *** GATES: PASS G-SPAN (zero class-energy violations in 2023/2025), G-SPUR (10->10, 12->11, 1->1), G-COAL148 (max rise 0.182 TWh vs the 0.5 bar — the gate that killed the composition family twice, which the rejected blanket arm failed at +0.98/+1.95/+2.73), G-DOF (zero new scalars), G-D2 (D-4 FAIL rows identical A<->B, the pre-existing CT_PEAKER condition), G-OWNER (C3a-2024/2025 keep PASS; C3a-2025 -7.9% nowhere near the -9.1% bound). G-BIT N/A, declared pre-solve (year-agnostic rule). *** THE TWO FAILURES, STATED AT FULL MAGNITUDE: G-SHED — the 2024 shed count had to FALL and did not (2 -> 2; no year rose, so the protective half holds). The arm still sheds at EXACTLY h2827/h3067, the ercot-172 object hours. This REFUTES the gate's founding hypothesis rather than showing a regression: the repair lifts W A Parish's partial factor 0.363 -> 0.578 at h2827, but the composed ceiling is f_window x f_partial = 0.6995 x 0.578 = 0.404 against a same-hour CEMS of 0.7843 — the residual there is FAULT 1, the double-count, which this charter explicitly fences off. G-C3c — the 2024 model tail moves 25 -> 23 against an actual 53, i.e. 2 hours FURTHER from actual on the already- ledgered model-class caveat (2023 61 and 2025 3 unchanged). *** WHY IT IS A KEEPER (rule 1 [R-STRUCT] + rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]): it deletes a mechanism that is measurably wrong — a multi-week average imposed as an hourly ceiling, which forbids output the plant's own CEMS record shows it produced — and replaces it with the same measured statistic at the finer grain, at zero DOF and with no flood. Rule 1 is explicit that a structurally-correct mechanism is not judged by the residual; here the residual mostly improves anyway. LOYO: parameter-free rule, so leave-one-year-out is N/A and per-year deltas stand in its place (ercot-173 precedent) — the gain is 2024-only and NO year degrades materially, so there is no in-sample gain bought with held-out degradation. *** WHAT THIS UNBLOCKS, NOT TAKEN HERE: with the repaired layer armed, G-COAL148 uses only 0.182 of its 0.5 TWh headroom, which is the first measured evidence for the DECISION-MEMO §5 sequel — that removing the double-count against a REPAIRED partial layer may no longer flood 2023/2025. That removal is a SEPARATE later adjudication and is NOT performed here. *** OPEN OWNER ITEM carried unchanged (ercot-176): econ*/peak* tranche rows record min_down=min_run=0, so rule-18 physics gates are vacuous at tranche-row grain (D3, sequenced after this). *** Supersedes 2026-08-09-run181-position-tail (kept on the dashboard as the immediate-prior comparison and as the A/B control's recipe). ERCOT holds no complete and no final marker, so no calibration-complete.json re-key applies. Full record: results/calibration/FINDING-ercot185-fault3-partial-layer-2026-08-09.md + docs/PRECOMMIT-ercot185-fault3-partial-layer-construction-2026-08-09.md + ercot185_ab.json + ercot185_coal148.json + ercot185_shaped_seam_proof.json.
